mapper.select: select mri.item_id, mri.record_id, mri.goods_id, mri.goods_name, mri.spec, mri.unit, mri.quantity, mri.item_status, mri.remark, mri.create_time, coalesce(g.stock_num, 0) as stock_num from edu_material_record_item mri left join edu_goods g on mri.goods_id = g.goods_id where mri.record_id = #{recordId} order by mri.item_id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_material_record_item (record_id, goods_id, goods_name, spec, unit, quantity, item_status, remark, create_time) values
(#{item.recordId}, #{item.goodsId}, #{item.goodsName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.unit}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.itemStatus}, #{item.remark}, now())
